description: Find models for a goal from two or three key words that name the task or the model, such as "upscale image", "remove background" or "text to image", best matches first. A model matches when one of its fields has every word. Style and subject words, such as "flat illustration" or "coffee cup", describe the output, so they belong in the prompt. A result for only part of the words names the words it left out. For a kind of task, search_models with categories also works. Follow the returned `get_model_schema` next action before running a model.

task.description: Two or three key words that name the task or the model, e.g. "upscale image", "remove background", "transcribe audio".

name: recommend_model

ignoredWords.description: Set when no model matched every search word: the words the results leave out.

discountPercent.description: Your discount on this model, in percent. It comes off the part of a charge paid from deposits; coupon credit and store revenue pay first, at the list price in pricing.

estimatedCostUsd.description: Estimated USD cost of one run: the average of past runs for a model billed by run time, or the listed estimate of a price set when the run ends. Null when there is no such estimate, as for a model priced by its options: see pricing.

searchUsed.description: Set when no model matched every search word: the part of the search the results are for.

title: Recommend Wiro models
